components.name: Top-Left Pin Selector
components.description: Asymmetric pushpin selector button in the top-left corner of the chatbox header.
components.css: .ds-pin-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 11px 11px 11px 3px; border: 1px solid rgba(194, 65, 12, 0.25); background: #c2410c; color: #faf9f6; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-pin-btn:hover { background: #9a3412; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-pin-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Send Button
components.description: Primary submission button in the chatbox composer toolbar.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid #111318; background: #111318; color: #faf9f6; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #252a34; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Pinned Element Chip
components.description: Context tray chip representing a pinned DOM element with live hover highlight.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 3px 7px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d6d3cd; border-radius: 7px; font-size: 11.5px; color: #111318; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #c2410c; } .ds-chip-badge { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 4px; background: #ffedd5; color: #9a3412; } .ds-chip-label { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11px; }

narrative.overview: ContextDrop lives overlaid on arbitrary host Ruby on Rails applications. Its aesthetic combines warm archival paper surfaces (#faf9f6) and deep obsidian ink (#111318) with two high-precision instrument accents: Pin Vermilion (#c2410c) for physical pin-drop affordances and Inspector Cobalt (#1d4ed8) for live DOM geometry and layer disambiguation.

rules.name: The Two-Signal Accent Rule
rules.body: Pin Vermilion (#c2410c) means 'pick or pin an element'; Inspector Cobalt (#1d4ed8) means 'active DOM geometry or layer selection.' Never swap them or use either for decorative backgrounds.

rules.name: The Earned Monospace Rule
rules.body: Monospace type is used exclusively for DOM tag names, CSS selectors, ancestor paths, and pixel dimensions—never as a decorative voice for prose or buttons.

dos: Do keep all widget styles strictly scoped inside the Shadow DOM (WIDGET_SHADOW_STYLES) or inline on [data-context-drop-ui] overlay elements so host application CSS is never mutated.
Do intercept pointerdown, mousedown, mouseup, click, and wheel in the capture phase during Pin Mode so underlying host links, buttons, and scroll containers are not triggered accidentally.
Do use the authored 1.75px stroke SVG icons from icons.ts for all actions.
donts: Don't use Unicode glyphs or emojis as UI icons.
Don't place kickers or eyebrows above headings inside the chatbox or dashboard.
Don't allow selection or unredacted screenshot capture of elements matching [data-feedback-ignore], [data-feedback-sensitive], input[type='password'], input[type='hidden'], or [autocomplete^='cc-'].
